close_reason: Migrated 7 UTCDateTime fields in jmap-calendars-types from String to UTCDate: event.rs Event.{created,updated} (Option<UTCDate>), notification.rs CalendarEventNotification.created (UTCDate) and NotificationFilterCondition.{after,before} (Option<UTCDate>), capability.rs CalendarsAccountCapability.{min,max}_date_time (UTCDate). Wire format unchanged. Fixed one downstream test in jmap-calendars-client to construct UTCDate explicitly. cargo test, cargo clippy -D warnings, RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc all clean.
description:
Audit follow-up from JMAP-g7wu.9.5. Migrate 7 public String fields documented as UTCDate/UTCDateTime to jmap_types::UTCDate.

Sites (all in crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/):

1. event.rs:135 — pub created: Option<String>  (JSCalendar UTCDateTime per RFC 8984 §4.1.5)
2. event.rs:139 — pub updated: Option<String>  (JSCalendar UTCDateTime per RFC 8984 §4.1.5)
3. notification.rs:68 — pub created: String  (doc says 'UTC date-time')
4. notification.rs:179 — pub after: Option<String>  (doc says 'UTCDate')
5. notification.rs:183 — pub before: Option<String>  (doc says 'UTCDate')
6. capability.rs:48 — pub min_date_time: String  (UTCDateTime per draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §1.6.1 line 347)
7. capability.rs:52 — pub max_date_time: String  (UTCDateTime per draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §1.6.1 line 351)

Change:
  Option<String> -> Option<UTCDate>
  String         -> UTCDate

Rationale: identical wire format to JMAP-g7wu.9.1's already-landed migration of utc_start/utc_end. JSCalendar UTCDateTime equals RFC 8620 UTCDate format (RFC 3339 with trailing 'Z'), so jmap_types::UTCDate newtype is the right type.

Out of scope (intentionally NOT included):
- LocalDateTime fields (CalendarEventFilterCondition::after/before at event.rs:338,343 — these are LocalDateTime per their doc comments).
- time_zone fields (IANA tz identifiers, not dates).
- recurrence_id_time_zone (IANA tz).
- sent_by (email addr-spec).

API break — 0.2.0 class. Coordinate with sibling beads for tasks-types / contacts-types / filenode-types per workspace cookie-cutter rule. canonical extension-types crate is jmap-mail-types (already fully migrated).

Test approach: update any RFC-example fixture tests to construct UTCDate via UTCDate::new_validated() or UTCDate::from() — wire JSON unchanged because UTCDate is a transparent newtype around String.

Acceptance:
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types passes.
- cargo clippy -p jmap-calendars-types -- -D warnings clean.
- All 7 fields use Option<UTCDate> or UTCDate.
- Downstream jmap-calendars-server and jmap-calendars-client still compile (the wire format and serde shape are unchanged).
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-calendars-types --no-deps clean.
title: UTCDate migration in jmap-calendars-types (JSCalendar UTCDateTime fields and capability bounds)
